title: Absolut Performance
description: A simple but working performance mod.
body:
In this ModPack,\
you will enjoy smooth gameplay along with stunning graphics.

Old laptop? No problem!\
New laptop? Even better!\
Good PC? No need for more!\
This ModPack runs on any device, old, new, bad, EVERYWHERE,\
with absolutely no problem!

Want proof?\
I have a 10 y/o GPU and got 75 FPS with shaders,\
Go to the gallery to see more!

Features:
1. 200+ FPS on any device
2. Compatibility with shaders
3. Smooth gameplay
4. Lots of QOL mods
   And MUCH more!

For any help or bug reports, join my discord using this link: https://discord.gg/C9b3anUaP9
